gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-nunito: Flat-weighted and loud: Cherry Swash cuts a horseshoe c into every line. Nunito, a plain sans with big round bowls and taller lowercase, softens the loudness and sounds friendly beside it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-amarna: Chunky, loud, horseshoe-mouthed: that's Cherry Swash at full volume. Amarna, with uniform strokes and uncluttered small counters, gives it a clean, contemporary floor to stand on, keeping the page tidy.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-assistant: Blunt and unmistakable, Cherry Swash bends its c into a wide horseshoe and never tapers a stroke where lines meet. Assistant's mouths stay open, and that openness is the whole trick.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Horseshoe curves, heavy diagonals: that is Cherry Swash. Where the heading commands, Bai Jamjuree, a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation, simply keeps its round letters light and unpinched, doing the quiet work.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Cherry Swash is all horseshoe curves and heavy, bent-straw lines. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std, a sans with restrained swell in its curves and connected counters, keeps paragraphs gentle going down the page.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-dotgothic16: A horseshoe-shaped c gives Cherry Swash its loudest signature, with diagonals pressed as hard as the verticals, line for line. DotGothic16, a plain sans, holds a tube-like thickness through every bend.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans: Horseshoe curves and heavy diagonals: Cherry Swash makes an entrance. Google Sans, a sans-serif with no thick-thin shift and terminals pulled well back, then settles in beside it and lets the text breathe.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans-flex: Cherry Swash walks in loud, with a horseshoe c and diagonals that hit hard. Google Sans Flex, a sans with ribbon-cut stroke ends and clean open curve gaps, keeps things tidy beneath it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-national-park: Loud, horseshoe-mouthed and unapologetic: Cherry Swash. National Park, a sans-serif drawn with one constant pen pressure and rounded letters, should read smoothly down a column with its open side showing.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: Loud, single-threaded and horseshoe-curved: Cherry Swash. Tenor Sans, a plain sans with stems slightly heavier than its hairlines, looks best when the heading runs a good deal larger than it.
